protocol.primary_family: Four paired training-seed score contrasts; Holm separately for t and exact sign-flip.
protocol.intervention: Only the goal snapshot changes and is refreshed at every pickup. Live code and trained RNN unchanged.
protocol.tangent: Unit perpendicular to inward radial direction, choosing the sign aligned with the arrival tangential component; positive perpendicular if exactly tied.
protocol.interpretation: Input interventions test use by frozen trained models; out-of-distribution messages and changed trajectories limit claims about training mechanisms.

geometric_reference.assumptions: Ideal straight boundary crossings through a circular goal, uniform impact parameter, negligible sampling overshoot. This is a reference model, not a fitted description of all trajectories.
geometric_reference.derivation: Average sqrt(r^2-b^2) over b uniform on [-r,r] is pi*r/4.

statistics: Eight paired training seeds. Four primary score contrasts, Holm t and sign-flip separately. Secondary metric families and four replication/descriptive score contrasts labeled exploratory. No equivalence claims from nonsignificance.
limitations: True-center directions are privileged oracle diagnostics.
Changing code geometry can be outside the learned input distribution.
Different actions change subsequent experience; first-discovery times remain exactly matched.
First-hit geometry shows information available in the input, not how a hidden unit computes it.
